faultPoints.description: The durable queue job is claimed before any story process starts.
The child execution identity and started timestamp are durably recorded.
The story source commit is created and its identity is captured.
Host-resolved validation runs against the committed story result.
The accepted contribution enters deterministic integration preparation.
The merge or cherry-pick is attempted and its exact outcome is recorded.
Validation runs against the assembled integration result.
Normalized qualification evidence is persisted before status promotion.
Final story/run closeout is decided only from explicit prior evidence.
